tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Absolute black. Dark chapter canvas for immersive hero scenes; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: pale-gray
tokens.usage: Pale gray. Light chapter canvas for feature bands, comparison blocks and editorial transitions; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Retail and product-list grounds, dense transactional sections; label on blue-action.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Near-black ink. Primary text and dark-fill controls on white and pale-gray (16.8:1 / 15.5:1).

tokens.name: graphite-a
tokens.usage: Graphite step A. Dark cards and media-control layer on black.

tokens.name: graphite-b
tokens.usage: Graphite step B. Deeper dark utility layer for control groupings.

tokens.name: graphite-c
tokens.usage: Graphite step C. Elevated dark supporting surfaces.

tokens.name: graphite-d
tokens.usage: Graphite step D. Darkest elevated step for separation in rich dark scenes.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Utility shell fill for filter buttons and configurator shells on white.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Soft border gray. Dividers and subtle outlines; decorative only (below 3:1).

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Mid border gray. Field outlines in configurators and filters (3.6:1 on white); secondary text on black (5.8:1).

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary neutral gray. Helper copy and metadata on white (5.1:1) and pale-gray (4.7:1).

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Utility dark gray. Dark-neutral crossover for store hairlines on black.

tokens.name: blue-action
tokens.usage: Action blue. Primary action fills and the focus ring; white label on it holds 4.7:1. Not for body text on pale-gray (4.3:1).

tokens.name: blue-link
tokens.usage: Body link blue. Inline links on white (5.6:1) and pale-gray (5.1:1).

tokens.name: blue-link-bright
tokens.usage: High-luminance link blue. Links on black (7.0:1) and graphite (4.9:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground: white retail canvas in Light, black chapter in Dark.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating chapter band and image-first card ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels set on surface-alt; configurator panels.

tokens.name: surface-shell
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for utility buttons, filter chips and input shells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised in both themes (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and metadata on surface and surface-alt. Dark theme: 5.8:1 on surface but only 4.1:1 on surface-alt (source pair kept); use it there at 17px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections; decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, option tiles and filter shells (3:1 or more on surface).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary action and selected-state borders.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: fill-contrast
tokens.usage: Restrained high-contrast button fill; dark ink on light grounds, inverts to pale gray in Dark.

tokens.name: on-fill-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on fill-contrast.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline and standalone text links.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring and selected state: 2px solid, 4.5:1 or more on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: Global nav bar: translucent black over content, with backdrop blur. Alpha is an assumption; the source gives no value.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Nav link text on nav-bg.

families.display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter Tight", "SF Pro Icons", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: "SF Pro Text", Inter, "SF Pro Icons", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: SF Pro Display, semibold, tight leading and tracking. Inter Tight stands in where SF Pro is unavailable.

styles.name: hero-xl
styles.usage: Largest hero line on a black or pale chapter.

styles.name: product-heading
styles.sample: Which one is right for you?

styles.name: promo
styles.usage: Module-level sub-heroes; may drop to 300 for contrast lines.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: SF Pro Text for navigation, controls, labels and dense commerce copy. Inter stands in; add +0.02 to +0.06 line height when it does.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A durable finish and a display that is easy to read in sunlight.

styles.name: body-emphasis
styles.usage: Emphasized labels and key values such as prices.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, helper labels, compact nav text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Fine print, micro labels, global nav links.

styles.name: legal
styles.usage: Dense metadata and legal support text.

spacing.note: 8px scaffolding with dense micro-steps for precision alignment. Values are the ones the source reuses, in px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Optical alignment of small labels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Base unit; vertical padding of compact buttons.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Optical alignment inside nav rows.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked options.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Utility interval: list spacing in dense retail.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of compact buttons.

tokens.name: space-17
tokens.usage: Field and option-tile padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Component padding and card gutters.

radius.note: Purposeful tiers by component class: field, card, spotlight, capsule, circle. Never one radius for everything.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny utility links and tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Standard rectangular buttons and compact fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, option tiles, configurator controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, module frames, commerce panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Larger modules and carousel lanes.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Spotlight containers.

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Large capsule actions.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Signature elongated pill CTAs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Circular media and carousel controls.

shadow.note: Depth is restrained: tonal contrast and surface stepping first. Shadows only on highlighted merchandise cards; alpha from the source (0.08 to 0.22), offsets assumed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Highlighted card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Highlighted card on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating overlays and menus; the deepest step.

breakpoint.note: Minimum widths of each layout tier.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: One-column modules, compact action rows.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Mixed one-to-two column transitions.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-wide
tokens.usage: Stable multi-column merchandising.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Full retail layouts and comparison tables.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-wide
tokens.usage: Hero expansion and broader section spacing.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: Maximum chapter breathing room.
